description: Farm-as-a-service import (Step 39 P2): push YOUR OWN recording for processing + certification. Upload objects first (signed-URL flow), then import by reference with sourceFormat MP4 | LEROBOT | MCAP | VRS | GOPRO and org-prefix-locked storage refs (VRS types T5; GOPRO folds + concatenates chapters server-side, multi-cam rigs type T6). Creates a processing-only FARM_SERVICE session (episode + fail-closed PII scrub, NO contribution/payout). Rig tiers T4 | T5 | T6. Requires capture:write.

rigTier.description: Server-enforced by format: VRS types T5; GoPro types T4 (single) / T6 (rig); mismatches 400.

metadata.description: Format-specific + schema round-trip metadata. GOPRO: one stream per chapter file; durationMs positive per chapter; chapter sets size-budgeted (413 beyond — pre-concatenate buyer-side); duplicate media across entries rejected; skew tolerance server-owned. LEROBOT: declare channelName/resolution/fps/codec on RGB and dims/names on telemetry so the export round-trips the source schema.

channelName.description: RGB: source camera/channel key (e.g. LeRobot "up"/"side"), slug ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,40}$ — preserved VERBATIM as the exported video modality key (observation.images.<channelName>); undeclared/duplicate names fall back to positional ego/ego_N.

codec.description: RGB: source video codec (e.g. "av1", "hevc"). Passthrough deliveries keep it; PII-blur re-encodes honestly report h264.

dims.description: Telemetry (POSE/IMU/GRIPPER_TELEMETRY): float-channel count — drives the exported vector shape (defaults: POSE 7, IMU 6, GRIPPER_TELEMETRY 1).

fileName.description: GOPRO (required): official camera file name — GX/GHzzNNNN.MP4 or GOPR/GPzzNNNN.MP4; recordings start at chapter 01/GOPR.

fps.description: RGB: capture frame rate — drives the exported fps and derived total_frames.

goproCamera.description: GOPRO rigs: rig position label (head / wrist-left / ...). Required for >1 camera.

names.description: Telemetry: per-channel names (length must equal dims) — exported verbatim as the vector feature names.

recordStartEpochMs.description: GOPRO rigs: this camera record-start epoch on the shared clock (>= sessionEpochMs).

resolution.description: RGB: "WIDTHxHEIGHT" (e.g. "640x480") — drives the exported video feature shape [height, width, 3].

sessionEpochMs.description: GOPRO rigs: shared QR-timecode session clock zero (one value across the push).

name: opentrain_session_import
